classification.candidate: |body vx|<0.1 m/s continuously >=1s, command vx>=0.5, time>0.5s
classification.confirmed: upright tilt<=45deg; no body collision in preceding .5s/window; X range<=.2m; >=80% samples in terrain-specific obstacle zone (flat stalls separately labelled)
classification.obstacle_zone: up: front foot X>=-3.25m and base X<-1.1m, |Y|<1m; down: front foot X>=1.25m and base X<3.5m, |Y|<1m
classification.lift: near obstacle, max front-foot clearance>.04m and max absolute front-foot vertical velocity>.15m/s
classification.phases: first_approach is first .5s after entering obstacle zone; lift and stall take precedence; end_window last1s overlaps other phases
